name: Conventional Detector Base

description: Common analogue base for the different analogue detectors, with screw terminals for COM loop in/out, output for an external LED, and a label holder recess. Supports detector locking screw.
standards: CE; conforms with AS7240.5 and AS7240.7
notes: Base-only quiescent and active current are both published as 0 mA — total draw depends entirely on the detector plugged in. External LED terminals: 5V, max 2 mA output.

name: T3 Addressable Sounder Base
description: Addressable sounder base combining a programmable sounder and an analogue detector base in one unit, connected directly on the COM loop. Three sound types with priority levels, programmed via EBLWin as a programmable output in FT1020G3 and FT128V2.
voltage: 24 V DC normal on COM loop (allowed 12-28)
notes: Quiescent published as '< 0.75 mA'; active published as '< 2.5 +/- 0.5 mA' — for battery sizing use 3.0 mA to be safe. Sound level 81 dB(A) at 1 metre, depending on sound type and direction. Sounder frequency 3650 +/- 350 Hz. Takes ONE address for the base plus a separate address for the detector plugged into it. External LED output 5V max 2 mA.

name: Surface Mount Relay Base, 230V
description: Surface mount base with built-in 5A relay offering pulse or continuous modes; for 140e and 3000 series smoke and heat alarms. Replaces the EIB128.
notes: Relay rated 5A. Datasheet references maximum carry current and input driving current but the values did not extract cleanly from the PDF layout — verify on the sheet before use.

name: Residential Systems Interface Base
description: Interface base connecting either the EIB650iWX or EIB603CX to the RFS and RFP residential fire systems via a 10-way ribbon cable into the wireless module connector. Provides RIL terminals to drive a remote indicator.

name: Surface Mount Base for 230V Mains Powered Alarms
description: Surface mount base to facilitate installation of bulky wiring and conduits; for use with Brooks 3000, 140RC and 160e series alarms.

name: Surface Mount Base with Relay and Battery Back-up
description: Surface mount base with integral relay and battery back-up, for use with 3000, 140RC and 160e Series alarms.

name: RadioLINK Wireless Interconnection Alarm Base (230V, for 140RC series)
description: Mains powered RadioLINK base with battery back-up giving RF wireless interconnect and remote control support; allows mixed wired and wireless systems.

name: Isolator Base 230V 4-Wire (for EIB3000 / EIB140RC / EIB160e Series)
description: Replaces the standard EIB160e/EIB140RC mounting plate where a four-wire smoke/heat alarm circuit with isolator feature is installed.

name: Intrinsically Safe Analogue Photoelectric Smoke Sensor
subcategory: intrinsically safe analogue photoelectric smoke detector
description: Intrinsically safe analogue photoelectric smoke sensor for hazardous areas. Functionally a 4301 smoke detector in a different housing with different IP rating. Takes one COM loop address, set with address setting tool 3314/4414 in NORMAL mode.
voltage: 15 - 17.3 V dc (15V nominal) from the IS COM line
protocol: IS COM line via 2842 barrier, then FireTracker COM loop (EBL
notes: Currents published in microamps/milliamps: quiescent 300 microamps max (= 0.3 mA), alarm 1.5 mA max, both drawn from the IS COM line — NOT from the main COM loop. Only 2840 and 2841 may connect to the IS COM line. Ii=95 mA, Pi=510 mW entity parameters shown.

name: Intrinsically Safe Analogue Heat Sensor
description: Intrinsically safe analogue heat sensor for hazardous areas. Functionally a 3308 heat detector in a different housing with different IP rating. Takes one COM loop address, set in NORMAL mode with tool 3314/4414.
voltage: 15 - 17.3 V dc (15V nominal) from the IS COM line
protocol: IS COM line via 2842 barrier, then FireTracker COM loop (EBL
notes: Quiescent 300 microamps max (= 0.3 mA), alarm 1.5 mA max, drawn from the IS COM line. Ii=110 mA, Pi=1.2 W entity parameters shown.

name: Enclosed Analogue Heat Detector (IP67)
description: Waterproof enclosed analogue addressable heat detector supplied with connection box, three compression glands and gasket. Algorithms for class A1, A2 S or B S. Used in FireTracker 1020G3 and 128V2 systems.
voltage: 24 V DC normal on COM loop
protocol: FireTracker COM loop (EBL) - classes A1, A2 S or B S
standards: AS7240.5; EC Certificate no. 0845-CPD-; ATEX compliance
notes: Cable length max 30 m. Detector mounting holes 2x(4x7mm) c/c 70mm. Accessories: label holder 3390, labels 3391.

name: Conventional Combination Heat Detector (Class A1R)
subcategory: conventional rate-of-rise + fixed temperature heat detector
description: Conventional combination heat detector, class A1R, alarming on both a fixed temperature level and a rate-of-rise condition. For use in FireTracker 512 and FireTracker 128 systems. Zone line connects to base 2324.
notes: Quiescent 0.015 mA is detector only.

name: Conventional Heat Detector, 60 degC, Class A2 S
description: Conventional fixed temperature (static) heat detector, 60 degC, Class A2 S, for use where smoke detectors cannot be used. Unleaded soldering, RoHS compliant.
notes: The datasheet's quiescent row reads 0 mA for the BASE only; detector draw depends on the type plugged into the base and current limitation is applied in all equipment. External LED terminals: zone line voltage minus 2V, max 10 mA output, no internal current limiter.

name: Conventional Heat Detector, 80 degC, Class B S
description: Conventional fixed temperature (static) heat detector, 80 degC, Class B S. Shares the 4375 datasheet and platform.
notes: Same electrical notes as 4375 — base quiescent 0 mA, detector draw depends on type, external LED max 10 mA.

name: Analogue Multi-Sensor Detector (Photoelectric and Thermal)
description: Analogue addressable multi detector combining one photoelectric (optical) smoke element and a thermal element, with advanced algorithms and learning function adapting to normal, smoke-steam or clean areas. Plugs into analogue base 3312 / 4313 / 3379.
voltage: 24 V DC nominal on COM loop (rated 28, allowed 12-30)
protocol: FireTracker COM loop (EBL) - Advanced or NORMAL mode
notes: Quiescent 0.3 mA, PLUS 0.025 mA if green polling LED is used. Active 1.3 mA incl. internal LEDs. External LED via base adds 0.5 mA. Operating -10 to +50 degC.

name: Analogue Photoelectric (Optical) Smoke Detector
description: Low profile analogue addressable photoelectric smoke detector with high-efficiency optical chamber, infrared LED and twin-lens photodiode, insect filter and optical labyrinth. Two red alarm LEDs plus green polling LED. Service signal at fixed contamination level. Plugs into analogue base 3312 / 4313 / 3379.
voltage: 24 V DC nominal on COM loop (rated 28, allowed 12-30)
protocol: FireTracker COM loop (EBL) - Advanced or NORMAL mode
notes: Quiescent 0.3 mA, PLUS 0.025 mA if the green polling LED option is programmed. Active 1.3 mA including internal LEDs (blinking 0.25s/0.75s). An external LED connected via the base adds a further 0.5 mA. Address set with tool 3314 / 4414; default address 000, NORMAL mode.

name: Conventional Photoelectric (Optical) Smoke Detector
description: Low profile conventional photoelectric smoke detector using the latest IC technology, unleaded soldering.
notes: Quiescent 0.04 mA is detector only. Total draw depends on the base the detector is plugged into.

name: Wireless Photoelectric Smoke Detector with inbuilt Sounder
subcategory: wireless photoelectric smoke detector with sounder
description: Wireless photoelectric smoke detector with low profile housing and built-in sounder offering three unique tones, for applications where running cables is difficult. Detector removal tamper switch and signal check push button. Up to 16 detectors per 4620AU base station, 4 base stations per COM loop.
protocol: 916MHz wireless to 4620AU base station, then FireTracker COM
notes: Sound output published as '>85dB' — no distance stated, so treat the 1m attribution with care. Typical battery life 6 years. Frequency 916MHz. Operating -10 to +55 degC.

name: Enclosed Conventional Heat Detector, 57 degC, Class A2 S (54-70 degC)
description: Conventional fixed temperature enclosed heat detector using a heat pick-up shield and bimetal sensing element, in a waterproof connection box with three cable inlets.
notes: Quiescent 0 mA. External current limitation is REQUIRED when active: for 6295-6297 it must be min 6 and max 40 mA (EBL equipment has current limitation built in). External LED output: zone line voltage minus 2V, max 10 mA, no internal current limiter.

name: Enclosed Conventional Heat Detector, 72 degC, Class B S (69-85 degC)
description: Conventional fixed temperature enclosed heat detector, 72 degC, class B S, with waterproof connection box.
notes: Quiescent 0 mA. Active current limitation must be min 6 / max 40 mA.

name: Enclosed Conventional Heat Detector, 87 degC, Class C S (84-100 degC)
description: Conventional fixed temperature enclosed heat detector, 87 degC, class C S, with waterproof connection box.
notes: Quiescent 0 mA. Active current limitation must be min 6 / max 40 mA.

name: Enclosed Conventional Heat Detector, 117 degC, Class E S (114-130 degC)
description: Conventional fixed temperature enclosed heat detector, 117 degC, class E S, with waterproof connection box.
notes: Quiescent 0 mA. NOTE the 6298 has a DIFFERENT active current limitation from its siblings: min 6 and max 30 mA (6295-6297 are min 6 / max 40 mA).

name: Heat (Thermal) Alarm, 230V mains with 9V alkaline battery back-up
description: Fast acting thermistor Class A1 heat alarm, hardwire interconnect, wireless interconnect when fitted with EiB168RC.
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption as 0.75W max, not mA. Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m.

name: Optical (Photoelectric) Smoke Alarm, 230V mains with 9V alkaline battery back-up
description: Mains powered optical smoke alarm with user-replaceable 9V alkaline back-up; hardwire interconnect, wireless interconnect when fitted with EiB168RC.
notes: Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m. Weight 350g.

name: Carbon Monoxide Alarm, 10-year lithium battery
description: Carbon monoxide alarm with AudioLINK data download; optional wireless interconnect via EI200MRF.
notes: Datasheet header also references a mains powered 230V variant with lithium battery back-up. No current figure published.

name: Heat Alarm, 230V mains with 10-year lithium battery back-up
description: Fast acting thermistor Class A1 heat alarm, hardwire interconnect up to 12 devices, AudioLINK data extraction, SmartLINK compatible.
notes: Standby power 0.25W. Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m.

name: Photoelectric Smoke Alarm, 230V mains with 10-year lithium battery back-up
description: Mains powered photoelectric smoke alarm with rechargeable 10-year lithium back-up, AudioLINK data extraction, SmartLINK compatible, Easi-fit base.
notes: Datasheet gives standby power as 0.25W, not mA — mA fields left empty deliberately. Sound level published as 85 dB(A) at 3m (not 1m).

name: Carbon Monoxide Alarm, 230V mains with 10-year lithium battery back-up
description: Proven electrochemical 10-year CO sensor, SmartLINK compatible, AudioLINK data extraction, large test button.
notes: Standby power 0.25W. Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m.

name: Photoelectric & Heat Multi-Sensor Alarm, 230V mains with 10-year lithium battery back-up
description: Multi-sensor alarm containing separate photoelectric and heat sensing elements; complies with all fire tests TF1-TF6 and TF8.
notes: Standby power 0.25W. Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m.

name: Heat & Carbon Monoxide Alarm, 230V mains with 10-year lithium battery back-up
description: Combined heat and carbon monoxide alarm with 10-year sensor life, SmartLINK compatible, AudioLINK data extraction, memory function.
notes: Standby power 0.25W. Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m.

name: Remote Wireless Heat Detector with RadioLINK, 10-year lithium battery
description: Wireless heat detector for use with RadioLINK smoke alarms, bases and accessories; low battery power warning, volt-free switched inputs.

name: Heat Alarm Externally Powered for Residential Systems
description: Externally powered fixed temperature heat alarm triggering at 58 degC, for use with Brooks residential fire panels via a compatible interface base. Suitable for kitchens; supplementary to smoke alarms only.
notes: Sound level 85 dB(A) minimum at 3 metres.

name: Intelligent Heat Alarm with RadioLINK+ module, 10-year lithium battery
description: Fixed temperature fast response thermistor heat alarm with wireless interconnect, ideal for kitchens; AudioLINK+ data download.
notes: Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m (except in Test mode). Product 115mm x 55mm.

name: Intelligent Heat Alarm, 10-year lithium battery
description: Fixed temperature fast response thermistor heat alarm; optional wireless interconnect, AudioLINK+ data download.
notes: Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m (except in Test mode).

name: Photoelectric Smoke Alarm Externally Powered for Residential Systems
description: Externally powered photoelectric smoke alarm for use with the Brooks range of residential fire panels via a compatible interface base (BAX16). Responsive to smouldering fires and dense smoke.
notes: Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3 metres.

name: Photoelectric RadioLINK+ Smoke Alarm, 10-year lithium battery, with AudioLINK
description: Wireless-interconnect photoelectric smoke alarm with automatic dust compensation and AudioLINK data download.
notes: Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3 metres.

name: Intelligent Photoelectric Smoke Alarm, 10-year lithium battery
description: Photoelectric smoke alarm with automatic dust compensation and powered-for-life lithium battery; optional wireless interconnect via EIB600MRF.
notes: Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m (except in Test mode).

name: Photoelectric & Heat Multi-Sensor RadioLINK+ Alarm, 10-year lithium battery, with AudioLINK
description: Wireless-interconnect multi-sensor alarm with integrated insect screen and dust compensation algorithm; AudioLINK+ data download.
notes: Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m (except in Test mode). Product 115mm x 55mm.

name: Photoelectric & Heat Multi-Sensor Alarm, 10-year lithium battery, with AudioLINK
description: Multi-sensor photoelectric and heat alarm, powered-for-life lithium battery, AudioLINK+ data download; optional wireless via EIB600MRF.
notes: Sound level 85 dB(A) at 3m (except in Test mode).

name: Residential Roof Space Heat Detector, 60 degC
description: Roof space heat switch for residential applications where standard smoke or heat alarms are unsuitable; contact closes at setpoint. Compatible with RFS1V2 / RFP residential fire panels.
notes: Setpoint 60 degC +/- 5%. Datasheet lists a quiescent current consumption row but the value did not extract from the two-column PDF layout — do not assume zero, verify on the sheet.

name: Residential Roof Space Heat Detector, 80 degC
description: 80 degC variant of the residential roof space heat switch; low power consumption, compact design.
notes: Shares the HS60V2 datasheet. Quiescent current row present but value not extractable from PDF layout.

name: Brooks 24V Tone and Voice Horn Sounder
description: Electronic horn sounder combining tone and digital voice message. Two inputs, typically Alert and Evacuation, selected by 24Vdc polarity. On power-up the unit sounds the tone for 10-12 seconds followed by a digital voice message, repeating until power is removed. Flying leads supplied.
notes: Current published as '<100mA (24Vdc; Australian evacuation tone)'. NEW ZEALAND TONE DRAWS MORE: <150mA. Horn sound output 100 dB (24Vdc, Australian evacuation tone). Turn-on voltage is 14V — below this no current is drawn, permitting end-of-line resistors for circuit supervision. Custom messages can be programmed.

name: Brooks 24V Tone and Voice Horn Sounder (D variant)
description: Variant within the Brooks 24V horn sounder family, sharing the tone plus digital voice message architecture.
notes: Family figures: <100mA on the Australian evacuation tone, horn output 100 dB. The datasheet does not break current down per suffix — confirm before sizing.

name: Brooks 24V Tone and Voice Horn Sounder (G variant)
description: Variant within the Brooks 24V horn sounder family.
notes: Family figures only — <100mA Australian tone, 100 dB horn output. Per-suffix currents are not published.

name: Brooks 24V Tone and Voice Flush Mount Speaker Sounder
description: Flush mount speaker sounder combining tone and digital voice message, with two polarity-selected inputs for Alert and Evacuation.
notes: Speaker sound output 85 dB (24Vdc, Australian evacuation tone) versus 100 dB for the horn versions. Current <100mA on the Australian tone, <150mA on the NZ tone. Turn-on voltage 14V.

name: Brooks 24V Tone and Voice Surface Mount Speaker Sounder
description: Surface mount speaker sounder combining tone and digital voice message, with two polarity-selected inputs for Alert and Evacuation.
notes: Speaker output 85 dB (Australian evacuation tone). Current <100mA Australian / <150mA NZ tone. Turn-on voltage 14V allows EOL resistor supervision.

name: Brooks 24V Tone and Voice Horn Sounder, New Zealand tone
description: New Zealand tone variant of the Brooks 24V electronic horn sounder.
notes: NZ evacuation tone draws <150mA, 50% more than the Australian tone variants. Sound output figure published on the datasheet is for the Australian tone, so no dB is recorded here.

name: Brooks 24V Tone and Voice Horn Sounder, New Zealand tone (G variant)
description: New Zealand tone G variant of the Brooks 24V electronic horn sounder.
notes: NZ evacuation tone draws <150mA.

name: Brooks Occupant Warning System Panel Kits
description: Packaged occupant warning system panel kits.
notes: Listed on the Brooks datasheet index and the Occupant Warning Systems page with an Operator's Manual only — no datasheet exists, so no specifications are recorded. OWSKIT appears to be a family designator rather than a single order code.

name: Remote Paging Desktop Microphone, Single Zone
description: Remote desktop public address microphone with dynamic goose neck microphone, single speaker zone selection, for occupant warning systems.
notes: Quiescent 9 mA, full load (all zones selected) 20 mA.

name: Remote Paging Desktop Microphone, 16 Zone
description: Remote desktop public address microphone with dynamic goose neck microphone and 16 speaker zone selections.
notes: The datasheet tabulates only two current columns for three models; PA-16 is taken to share the 40 mA quiescent / 100 mA full load column with PA-8. Confirm before sizing.

name: Remote Paging Desktop Microphone, 8 Zone
description: Remote desktop public address microphone with dynamic goose neck microphone and 8 speaker zone selections.
notes: Quiescent 40 mA, full load (all zones) 100 mA — substantially more than the PA-1. The datasheet publishes two current columns; PA-8 and PA-16 appear to share the higher column.

name: 100mm 100V 5W Flush Mount Speaker, White
description: Low profile flush mount ceiling speaker certified to AS ISO7240.24:2015, penetrating the ceiling by only 53mm. Terminal block for loop in / loop out wiring, 22uF BP capacitor fitted.
notes: Max sound 95 dB at 5W @ 1m. Note the datasheet's first order-code line contains a typo, 'AS ISO7204.24', corrected to AS ISO7240.24 on the second line.

name: 100mm 100V 5W Flush Mount Speaker, Black
description: Black bodied variant of the 100mm 5W flush mount ceiling speaker.
notes: Max sound 95 dB at 5W @ 1m. Ceiling penetration 53mm.

name: 10W 100V IP66 Horn Speaker, Grey
description: Horn speaker certified to AS ISO7240.24 for fire and evacuation announcements where a high degree of speech articulation and program clarity is required. Typical applications: schools, train and bus stations, airports, car parks and plant rooms. Stainless steel mounting hardware, two cable glands for loop in / loop out.
notes: IMPORTANT ADVANTAGE: the datasheet states this model requires NO external equalisation to meet AS ISO7240.24, unlike the SPKSM/SPKFM ceiling speakers. The sound pressure row is present but the numeric value did not extract from the PDF layout.

name: 100mm 100V 5W Surface Mount Speaker, White
description: Surface mount ceiling speaker with flame retardant housing and tuned PA driver to suit AS ISO7240.24 approval requirements. One-Shot design snap-fits in seconds. Terminal block for loop in / loop out wiring. Fitted with 22uF BP capacitor.
notes: Max sound 95 dB at 5W @ 1m. IMPORTANT: the datasheet notes this model REQUIRES equalisation to meet the certified sound-system loudspeaker requirements (unlike the SPKHORN10QF which does not).

name: 100mm 100V 5W Surface Mount Speaker, Black
description: Black bodied variant of the 100mm 5W surface mount speaker.
notes: Max sound 95 dB at 5W @ 1m. Requires equalisation to meet certified requirements.

name: 200mm 100V 15W Surface Mount Speaker
description: 200mm 15 watt surface mount speaker in the Brooks occupant warning system range.
notes: Part number and 100V/15W rating taken from the Brooks Occupant Warning Systems page. NO datasheet exists for this variant in the Brooks datasheet index (only the 5W SPKSM200-5 is documented), so no dB, IP or standards figures are recorded.

name: 200mm 100V 5W Surface Mount Speaker, White
description: 200mm surface mount speaker with flame retardant housing and tuned PA driver, One-Shot snap-fit design. Higher output than the 100mm models. 22uF BP capacitor fitted.
notes: Max sound 101 dB at 5W @ 1m — 6 dB more than the 100mm 5W models at the same power.

name: Analogue Base with Short Circuit Isolator
subcategory: analogue addressable base with built-in loop isolator
description: Common analogue base with built-in short circuit isolator dividing the COM loop into segments, so a short circuit disables only the affected segment. Screw terminals for COM loop in/out and external LED (RIL). Address label for both detector and isolator addresses.
notes: Quiescent is published as 'less than or equal to 1.3 mA' EXCLUDING the detector. Up to 64 isolators (4313 and/or 4370) per COM loop. The isolator takes its own COM loop address, set with an address setting tool. External LED terminals: 5V, max 2 mA.

name: Addressable Manual Call Point with Isolator
subcategory: addressable manual call point with built-in isolator
description: Addressable manual call point with built-in short-circuit isolator and protection against accidental operation. Frangible element activates a built-in microswitch. Test/cover removal key allows routine testing without breaking the element.
notes: Currents published as 'quiescent / active 1.6 / 2.7' mA from the COM loop. The MCP and its isolator together take only ONE COM loop address. Wires must be disconnected before the COM loop wires are connected.

name: Enclosed Addressable Manual Call Point with Isolator (IP56)
subcategory: weatherproof addressable manual call point with isolator
description: Enclosed IP56 addressable manual call point with built-in short-circuit isolator, suitable for outdoor use. Test key permits routine testing without breaking the frangible element.
notes: Currents published as 'quiescent / active 1.6 / 2.7' mA. Takes one COM loop address for MCP and isolator combined. Must not be exposed to temperatures below the datasheet minimum.

name: Wireless Manual Call Point, 10-year lithium battery
description: Wireless MCP that transmits an RF alarm signal on activation, causing all alarms in the RadioLINK system to sound. Unique house coding.
notes: Relay contacts rated 250 volt AC - 5A resistive. Operating range 0 to 40 degC.

name: Addressable Multipurpose Remote Input / Output Unit (8 in / 8 out)
description: Generic remote I/O unit usable inside the CIE or remotely on a COM loop (requires 2 pairs, power and COM loop). Provides 8 non-supervised programmable N/O or N/C clean contact inputs and 8 programmable changeover relay contact outputs, plus 8 external LED outputs.
notes: Quiescent 35 mA @ 24V DC, activation 100 mA — a heavy loop/PSU load compared with detectors. Relay contacts 1A @ 30V DC changeover. LED outputs 5VDC max 15 mA per LED, pulsed 2ms ON / 14ms OFF.

name: Addressable Multipurpose Remote Input / Output Unit (16 Input, 16 Relay Output, 16 LED Output)
description: Sixteen channel version of the addressable multipurpose remote I/O unit: 16 non-supervised programmable N/O or N/C clean contact inputs, 16 programmable changeover relay outputs, 16 LED outputs.
notes: Shares the 2210 datasheet, which publishes ONE set of currents (35 mA quiescent, 100 mA activation) for both models. Given the 2211 has double the channel count, verify with Brooks before relying on the shared figure for the 2211.

name: Addressable Generic I/O Mimic Module (16 Inputs / 48 Outputs)
description: Loop module providing up to 16 non-supervised clean contact inputs and up to 48 non-supervised outputs (e.g. LEDs) for mimic indication. Usable remotely or inside the CIE; requires 2 pairs from the FT128, FT512 or FT1020G3 for 24V and COM loop.
notes: TWO supplies: COM loop quiescent is a range, min 4 mA / max 6 mA (I recorded 6, the max). The separate 24V DC supply draws min 10 mA (4582 board) to max 100 mA depending on the number of LEDs lit — recorded as the alarm figure. Count both. 48 LED outputs at 5VDC max 15 mA each; 16 inputs at 0.1-3 mA per input. All figures valid at 24 VDC, 25 degC.

name: Intrinsically Safe Barrier Unit
description: IS barrier unit mounted outside the risk area, connecting the IS COM line to the CIE via the COM loop. Optocoupler separation of COM loop from IS COM line; DC/DC converter isolates the 24V supply. Screw terminals for COM loop in/out and 24V dc in/out.
voltage: 12 - 30 V dc (24V nominal) on COM loop; IS COM line 15 - 17.
notes: IMPORTANT for battery calcs: quiescent 10 mA max is drawn FROM THE COM LOOP; the 50 mA alarm figure is drawn FROM THE EXTERNAL 24 V DC SUPPLY, not the loop. The barrier takes NO COM loop address and is not programmed via Win software, but a 24 V DC (50 mA) supply is required and can come from the CIE or any external PSU. Io=93.2 mA on I+2/I-2.

name: 3361 Generic Input / Output Module
description: Generic multipurpose input/output loop module. Required alongside an external relay to provide the FTLEDM buzzer silence facility; the 4461 can be reconfigured to emulate a 3361 for backwards compatibility.
notes: Part number confirmed in the FTLEDM and 4461 datasheets. No standalone datasheet reachable — no electrical specs recorded.

name: Alarm Acknowledgement Module (AAM)
description: Loop powered alarm acknowledgement module supporting the Alarm Investigation Facility, used in conjunction with sounder base 3379. Controls standard sounder base alarm level; one address per module, up to five detectors per module. Surface or flush mounting, multiple time settings for acknowledgement.
notes: Quiescent 2 mA, alarm 5 mA. Replaces the discontinued 3340. Configuration is one or more detectors (4401/4400), up to five sounder bases 3379, and one AAM, all on the same COM loop. Sounder base 3379 must be programmed with the trigger. Smoke detectors in an AAF zone cannot be programmed as 2-unit-dependent.

name: Addressable Multipurpose Input/Output Module with Isolator
subcategory: addressable I/O module with loop isolator
description: Loop powered multipurpose input/output module in an IP65 enclosure, offering two monitored inputs, one isolated voltage input and two programmable relay outputs. Programmable as a fire fan control and status interface module, or reconfigurable as a 3361 generic I/O module for backwards compatibility. Built-in isolator. Zone line input for conventional devices.
voltage: 24 V DC normal on COM loop
notes: Quiescent published as 'less than or equal to 4.3 mA' including Z/In0. Operating -10 to +50 degC. Compatible with FT128V2 and FT1020G3.

name: 8 Zone Expansion Board
description: Eight zone expansion board, an optional add-on for the FT12819 and FTG319 fire indicator panels.
notes: Part number confirmed in the optional panel add-ons tables of both panel datasheets. No standalone datasheet — no electrical specs recorded.

name: 8 Relay Expansion Board
description: Eight relay expansion board, an optional add-on for the FT12819 and FTG319 fire indicator panels.
notes: Part number confirmed in the optional panel add-ons tables of both panel datasheets. No standalone datasheet — no electrical specs recorded.

name: 4582 I/O Matrix Board
description: I/O matrix board used by the FTLEDM mimic panel and by the 2212 generic I/O mimic module.
notes: Maximum number of 4582 boards per loop is 6 for FT1020G3, and 4 per loop for FT128 and FT512 (per the 2212 datasheet). No standalone datasheet.

name: Addressable Base Station for Wireless Devices
subcategory: wireless base station with loop isolator
description: Addressable base station interfacing wireless devices to a COM loop in FT1020G3 or FT128. Up to 4 base stations can be monitored on each COM loop, and up to 16 wireless photoelectric smoke detectors on each base station. Built-in short circuit COM loop isolator requiring no separate loop address.
notes: Datasheet states 'Voltage 24V DC 40mA'. Dimensions 240 x 150 x 31 mm. Operating -10 to +55 degC.

name: 5054 Remote Display Unit
description: Coloured touch screen display distributing fire alarm system status information; configurable as a presentation unit or alert annunciation unit with adjustable buzzer. Compatible with FT128V2 and FT1020G3.
notes: Current consumption is not published on this datasheet.

name: Gateway
description: Gateway module, an optional add-on for the FTG319 / FT1020G3 fire indicator panel.
notes: Part number confirmed in the FTG319 optional panel add-ons table. No standalone datasheet — no electrical specs recorded.

name: TLON Network Board
description: TLON network board enabling networking of FTG319 / FT1020G3 fire indicator panels.
notes: Part number confirmed in the FTG319 optional panel add-ons table. No standalone datasheet — no electrical specs recorded.

name: Local Gas Control Station
description: Local control station for gaseous extinguishing systems, with built-in audible warning for gas isolate, two-step operation for gas release to prevent accidental operation, and resettable gas release control. The GAS RELEASE function provides a manual 24Vdc initiate signal to gas actuators.
notes: Datasheet explicitly states 'No current draw in quiescent state', hence 0 mA. When gas discharge is inhibited an audible warning sounds and visual indication is given at the LCS and at the panel.

name: RadioLINK Module for Carbon Monoxide Alarms
description: Plug-in RF upgrade module for EI208W and EI208DW CO alarms; interconnects up to 12 wireless alarms/devices.

name: Generic Input / Output Module for Sprinkler Flow Switch or MCP
description: Zone device interfacing a manual call point or sprinkler flow switch to the BARFS-1 residential fire panel; clean contact input.
notes: Currents published as Quiescent@12V / Alarm@12V.

name: SmartLINK RF Wireless Interconnection Module for 3000 Series
description: Plug-in RF upgrade module for mains powered 3000 Series alarms; interconnects up to 12 devices wirelessly, remote alarm learn entry.
notes: Powered from the host alarm — no independent supply voltage published. 5 year guarantee.

name: Wireless Switch Input Module, 10-year lithium battery
description: Standalone module accepting a hard-wired volt-free switch contact (e.g. from a sprinkler system) and transmitting it to RadioLINK alarms, bases and accessories.
notes: Input: volt-free switch contact. Weight 180g.

name: RadioLINK Panel Module (for use with security / fire panels)
description: Connects RadioLINK alarms to security or fire panels for additional alarms and remote signalling; panel can trigger all smoke/CO alarms to sound.
notes: Datasheet states 'Current Required: 15mA (Standby max.)'. Alarm voltage input 11-30 VDC.

name: RadioLINK Wireless Relay Module with 10-year lithium battery back-up
description: Standalone or Easi-fit relay module for 140RC, 160e and 3000 Series alarms; latching or 5-second pulse relay operation.
notes: Datasheet states 'Supply Voltage: 230V AC 40 mA'. Relay contacts rated 250V AC 5A resistive.

name: RadioLINK+ RF Wireless Interconnect Module (for 10-year lithium battery models)
description: Plug-in RF upgrade module for EIB650iC/EIB650iW and EIB603TYC; unique house coding confines communication to the intended system.
notes: RF power +10dBm.

name: FTLEDM Addressable MIMIC Panel
description: Fully programmable COM loop remote LED mimic panel with green power ON indicator, yellow fault indicator, 22 red zone alarm indicators, buzzer and buzzer silence switch. Uses the 4582 I/O matrix board and 2 x 12 LED mimic boards.
notes: TWO separate supplies, both published: 24V supply quiescent 4mA / alarm 100mA max (recorded here); COM loop quiescent 8.8mA / active 8.8mA. Count both when sizing. Requires an external relay and I/O multipurpose 3361 for the buzzer silence facility.

name: BARFS-1 Input / Output Board
description: Zone device board interfacing the BARFS-1 residential panel to external equipment. Clean contact input for MCP or sprinkler flow switch; 12V alarm output (fused 1A) drives strobes or vibration pads. Jumpers JP1 alarm priority, JP2 relay common power (0V/12V/isolated), JP3 relay operation.
notes: Relay current rating 1A. Fitted in an x-series rectangular plastic base.

name: Single Zone Mains Powered Smoke Alarm Panel
description: Single zone mains powered smoke alarm panel.
notes: Listed on the Brooks datasheet index with an Operator's Manual only — no datasheet exists, so no specifications are recorded.

name: BARFS-1 Single Zone Residential Fire Safety System Panel
description: Single zone automatic fire detection and alarm panel for residential applications, used with compatible smoke/heat alarms and auxiliary devices. Two selectable alarm priorities: priority 1 activates the alarm output relay and all alarm sounders; priority 2 activates alarm sounders only.
standards: Designed to meet the Building Code of Australia (Smoke Alarm System) requirements
notes: Supply 3 Amp @ 12 V DC. Standby supply 12V/7AH sealed lead acid. Alarm outputs supervised 12V DC 1 Amp. Panel's own quiescent current not published.

name: FireAlert FA40 RCIE (Residential Control and Indicating Equipment)
description: FireAlert smoke alarm system residential control and indicating equipment.
notes: Part number taken from the Brooks FireAlert residential systems page. No datasheet reachable — no electrical specs recorded.

name: FireTracker 4 Loop Addressable Fire Indicator Panel (networkable)
description: Intelligent analogue addressable panel (FDCIE) providing full integration between the fire alarm system and the Occupant Warning System. This is the marketing part number under which the FTG319 hardware is sold.
notes: Listed as a current product on the Brooks addressable systems page; FTG319 is the order code appearing on the datasheet. Treat FT1020G3 and FTG319 as the same platform.

name: FireTracker FT128 Single Loop Analogue Addressable Fire Alarm System (19 inch rack)
description: Single COM loop intelligent analogue addressable FIP in a 19 inch rack enclosure with interchangeable display modules. 1 supervised programmable input, 2 programmable supervised 24V outputs, 2 x 24V fused outputs. Supports Loop Check.
voltage: Primary 230V AC 1.6A; secondary/system 24 Volt DC nominal
protocol: FireTracker COM loop (EBL) - 1 loop, up to 255 loop units
notes: Listed on the Brooks datasheet index as 'FT128 (discontinued)'. NO panel standby or alarm current is published — do not use this entry for a battery calculation without measuring. Optional add-ons: 4580, 4581, 1598, 1200 Series. Operating 0 to +40 degC.

name: Gaseous Extinguishing System Control Panel
description: Extinguishing control panel to monitor and control a gas extinguishing system.
standards: AS4214-2002 (Gaseous fire extinguishing systems - Detection, Actuation and Control Systems)
notes: Part number and standard taken from the Brooks gas extinguishing system page. No datasheet reachable — no electrical specs recorded.

name: FireTracker FT2FP Dual Zone Conventional Fire & Indicating Equipment
description: Complete two-zone conventional CIE with power supply, PSU supervision and all inputs/outputs required for remote monitoring, in a lockable door enclosure. Two zone circuits with configurable latching/non-latching, two configurable zone relay dry-contact outputs.
notes: Battery backup sized for 96 hours quiescent followed by 30 minutes alarm. Weight 10 kg without backup battery. Panel standby current itself is not published.

name: FireTracker FT420 Conventional CIE
description: Conventional control and indicating equipment in the FireTracker range.
standards: AS7240.2 and AS7240.4; CSIRO ActivFire approved
notes: ActivFire approval and standards stated on the Brooks conventional systems page. No datasheet reachable — no electrical specs recorded.

name: FireTracker FT1020G3 Four Loop Analogue Addressable Fire Detection System (19 inch rack)
description: Four replaceable COM loop intelligent analogue addressable FIP with large graphic display and modular interchangeable display modules. 4 programmable inputs, 4 programmable supervised 24V outputs, 6 x 24V fused outputs. Networkable via TLON.
voltage: Primary 230V AC 1.6A; secondary/system 24 Volt DC nominal
protocol: FireTracker COM loop (EBL) - 4 loops, up to 253 loop units e
notes: NO panel standby or alarm current is published. Optional add-ons: 4580, 4581, 5090 TLON network board, 5088 gateway, 1200 Series display modules, 12NCI nurse call serial data interface. Operating 0 to +40 degC.

name: FTOne - One Loop Addressable Fire Indicator Panel
description: Single loop intelligent analogue addressable fire indicator panel (FDCIE) with integration to the Occupant Warning System.
notes: Listed as a current product on the Brooks FireTracker addressable page. No standalone datasheet was reachable — no electrical specs recorded.

name: RFP V2 12 Zone Residential Fire Panel
description: Supervised 12 zone residential fire indicator panel; same platform as RFP6V2.
voltage: Power supply input 230V AC, output 14.5 VDC; standby 12V SLA
notes: Shares the RFP V2 datasheet. Alarm outputs 12VDC 1 Amp maximum. Panel standby current not published.

name: RFP V2 18 Zone Residential Fire Panel
description: Supervised 18 zone residential fire indicator panel; same platform as RFP6V2.
voltage: Power supply input 230V AC, output 14.5 VDC; standby 12V SLA
notes: Shares the RFP V2 datasheet. Alarm outputs 12VDC 1 Amp maximum. Panel standby current not published.

name: RFP V2 6 Zone Residential Fire Panel
description: Supervised 6 zone residential fire indicator panel used with compatible smoke/heat alarms; alarm locate function, general alarm confirmation period, dry contacts per zone, ancillary device control.
voltage: Power supply input 230V AC, output 14.5 VDC; standby 12V SLA
standards: Designed to meet the requirements of the Building Code of Australia (BCA); AS1670 design principles applied
notes: Alarm outputs 12VDC 1 Amp maximum. Compatible alarms include EIB650IWX and EIB603CX. Brooks states the RFP V2 is a smoke alarm system, NOT a smoke detection system per AS1670.1. Panel standby current not published.

name: RFS1V2 Residential Fire Multi Zone System
description: Residential fire multi-zone system listed as the compatible controller for the HS60V2 / HS80V2 roof space heat detectors and the BAX16 interface base.
notes: Part number appears in the compatible-devices table of the roof space heat detector datasheet. No standalone datasheet reachable — no electrical specs recorded.

name: Loop Monitored 4 Amp External Power Supply
description: External power supply connected to and monitored from a COM loop, comprising a 230V AC / 24V DC rectifier (1537) and charger board (3367), with space inside the housing for two 12V 6.5-7.5 Ah batteries. Larger batteries up to 60 Ah must be placed outside. Mains failure generates a fault at the CIE.
voltage: 230 V AC primary; 24 V DC secondary output
notes: COM loop quiescent published as '< 15 mA'. Board 3367 draws an additional 25 mA when running on backup battery power. OUTPUT CAPACITY DEPENDS ON JUMPER JP2: low current charging mode (JP2 open, batteries under 27 Ah) gives 24V DC output up to 2.2 A; high current charging mode (JP2 shunted, 28-60 Ah batteries) gives only 0.85 A. Listed on the Brooks index as '3366AU'. Address set with an address se

name: Charger Board for 3366 External Power Supply
description: Battery charger board fitted inside the 3366 external power supply, with jumper JP2 selecting low or high current charging mode.
notes: Draws 25 mA when the system is running on backup battery power. Not sold as a standalone catalogue item as far as the public site shows — part number appears within the 3366 datasheet.

name: BPSU5 5 Amp Standalone Power Supply
description: Fully supervised 5 amp standalone power supply with power supply supervision module and local sounder for fault warning. Fault states signalled: battery charger low (<26.5V), 50% battery capacity (battery voltage <24V), battery disconnected, auto battery test fail (latching fault). System quiescent load is disconnected at deep discharge.
voltage: Secondary supply input 28V dc; output 27.5V dc
standards: Power supply supervision module complies with AS4428.5
notes: Quiescent 50 mA, active (fault) 73 mA — these are the PSU's OWN consumption, additional to the connected load.

name: Mains Base, Red, 240V (for Brooks Strobes & Sounders)
description: Mains deep base incorporating a small 24Vdc supply, allowing compatible sounders and strobes to be operated directly from 110 or 230Vac supplies.
notes: Output current 100 mA MAXIMUM — this caps what can be hung off one base. Compatible devices: BS1060X Brooks Strobe, MRSC Roshni Sounder, MFRSX Flashni Sounder/Strobe.

name: Mains Base, White, 240V (for Brooks Strobes & Sounders)
description: White variant of the mains deep base with integral 24Vdc supply for compatible sounders and strobes.
notes: Output current 100 mA max. Shares the BR240V datasheet.

name: Gaseous Extinguishing Warning Signs
description: Rugged rigid steel construction gaseous extinguishing warning signs with two or four wire connection to the gas control panel, steady or flashing light, and a built-in warning buzzer configurable to steady or pulsing sound. Brooks OWS series electronic sounders can be associated.
notes: Datasheet states 'No current consumption in quiescent state' (hence 0 mA quiescent) and 'Nominal <100mA (@24Vdc)' when active. BWS Series is a family designator — confirm the specific sign order code with Brooks.

name: Gaseous Extinguishing Warning Sign with Integrated Timer and Speaker (DNE)
subcategory: gas extinguishing warning sign with timer and speaker
description: Two wire warning sign to the gaseous extinguishing control panel, with integrated timer and speaker, steady or flashing light.
notes: Datasheet states 'No current consumption in quiescent state'. Nominal active current <215mA @24Vdc — the heaviest of the warning sign range. IMPORTANT: the datasheet adds 'The current consumption is calculated for the Australian tones (NZ tones add 50mA)', so NZ configurations draw up to 265 mA. Sound pressure level published as a range 83 dBA to 86 dBA at 1m; I recorded the conservative 83.

name: Gaseous Extinguishing Warning Sign with Integrated Timer and Speaker (EVAC)
subcategory: gas extinguishing warning sign with timer and speaker
description: EVAC variant of the two wire gaseous extinguishing warning sign with integrated timer and speaker.
notes: Shares the BWS-TS datasheet. Zero quiescent, <215mA active on Australian tones, +50mA for NZ tones. Sound pressure 83-86 dBA at 1m.

name: Addressable Wall Mount VAD with Siren and Isolator - Red
subcategory: addressable wall mount VAD with siren and loop isolator
description: Wall mount addressable VAD combining a high output siren with a cylindrical-distribution lens, for open areas or higher than normal background noise. Coverage 5m switchable to 2.5m, max mounting height 2.4m, coverage volume code C-2.4-5 giving 60 cubic metres (27 at reduced setting). Flash rate 1Hz switchable to 0.5Hz.
standards: Meets AS7240.23 (0.4 Lux/m2); conforms to EN54.23 and EN54.17
notes: Sound output published as 'Max 96dB' — the datasheet does not state the measurement distance, so treat the 1m attribution with care. NO current figure is published for this device despite it being a sounder — do not assume it matches the 4480.

name: Addressable Beacon with Shallow Base
description: Addressable LED beacon in a red ABS housing, connected directly on the COM loop and powered from it. Low current consumption via LED technology.
notes: Quiescent 1.7 mA. Maximum 10 beacons can be connected to a COM loop. Alarm/active current is not published. All current consumptions valid at 24 V DC nominal, 25 degC.

name: Addressable Wall Mount Visual Alarm Device with Isolator - Red
subcategory: addressable wall mount VAD with loop isolator
description: Addressable wall mount VAD with built-in COM loop short circuit isolator and patented lens design distributing light to the illumination required by EN54.23 using minimum current. Coverage volume W-2.4-7.5. Locking base prevents easy removal.
standards: Meets AS7240.23 (0.4 Lux/m2 over entire area); conforms to EN54.17 and EN54.23
notes: CURRENT IS A RANGE: datasheet states 'Current 10 - 25mA' dependent on setting. Coverage switch (down from 7.5m) halves consumption, and flash rate switch (1Hz to 0.5Hz) halves it again. I recorded 25 mA as worst case — do NOT treat as fixed. Compatible with FT128V2 and FT1020G3, software versions 2.4.x or later.

name: Addressable Ceiling Mount Visual Alarm Device with Isolator - Red
subcategory: addressable ceiling mount VAD with loop isolator
description: Addressable ceiling mount VAD with built-in COM loop short circuit isolator. Coverage 7.3m (switchable to 3m), max mounting height 3m, coverage volume code C-3-7.3 giving 125 cubic metres (21 cubic metres at the reduced setting). Flash rate 1Hz switchable to 0.5Hz. Ideal for bedrooms, bathrooms and toilets.
standards: Meets AS7240.23 (0.4 Lux/m2); conforms to EN54.17 and EN54.23
notes: This datasheet does NOT publish a current figure (unlike the 4480 wall variant which gives 10-25 mA). Coverage and flash-rate switches each reduce power consumption by 50%. Weight 100g, white flash, red body.

name: Addressable Ceiling Mount Visual Alarm Device with Isolator - White
subcategory: addressable ceiling mount VAD with loop isolator
description: White bodied variant of the 4481 addressable ceiling mount VAD with isolator. Coverage 7.3m switchable to 3m.
standards: Meets AS7240.23; conforms to EN54.17 and EN54.23
notes: Shares the 4481 datasheet. No current figure published.

name: Brooks Strobe 10-60VDC, Blue Lens, Shallow Base
description: Xenon strobe with wide DC operating voltage, increased efficiency, current surge suppression, automatic synchronisation (10ms over 30 mins) and constant performance over the voltage range.
ipRating: IP54 shallow base; IP65 deep b
notes: CURRENT IS A RANGE: datasheet states 'Current Solex 10 - 80mA @ 24VDC'. I recorded 80 mA as worst case. Compatible mains bases BR240V (red) / BW240V (white).

name: Brooks Strobe 10-60VDC, Amber Lens, Shallow Base
description: Amber lens variant of the Brooks xenon strobe range.
ipRating: IP54 shallow base; IP65 deep b
notes: Current 10-80 mA @ 24VDC; 80 recorded as worst case. Shares the BS1060 datasheet.

ipRating: IP54 shallow base; IP65 deep b

description: Green lens variant of the Brooks xenon strobe range.
ipRating: IP54 shallow base; IP65 deep b
notes: Current 10-80 mA @ 24VDC; 80 recorded as worst case.

name: Brooks Strobe 10-60VDC, Clear Lens, Shallow Base
description: Clear lens variant of the Brooks xenon strobe range.
ipRating: IP54 shallow base; IP65 deep b
notes: Current 10-80 mA @ 24VDC; 80 recorded as worst case.

name: Visual Alarm Device, Ceiling Mount (conventional)
description: Conventional ceiling mount visual alarm device with unique lens design distributing light in a cylindrical shape to the illumination specified by AS7240.23. Designed for installation up to 3m height, up to 7.5m coverage volume, discrete appearance.
notes: CURRENT IS A RANGE: 'Current 10 - 25mA dependent on setting'; headline claims ultra low consumption of 10mA. 25 mA recorded as worst case.

name: Visual Alarm Device, Ceiling Mount, Red - 7.5m coverage
description: Red bodied conventional ceiling mount VAD with 7.5m coverage.
notes: Shares the BVADC datasheet. Current 10-25 mA dependent on setting.

name: Visual Alarm Device, Ceiling Mount, White - 7.5m coverage
description: White bodied conventional ceiling mount VAD with 7.5m coverage.
notes: Shares the BVADC datasheet. Current 10-25 mA dependent on setting.

name: Visual Alarm Device, Wall Mount (conventional)
description: Conventional wall mount visual alarm device with patented lens design distributing light to the illumination specified by AS7240.23 using minimum current consumption. Up to 7.5m room coverage. Compatible with the full range of 6 bases.
notes: CURRENT IS A RANGE: 'Current 10 - 25mA dependent on setting'. The datasheet headline claims 'Ultra low current consumption of 10mA'; switching flash rate to 0.5Hz reduces consumption. I recorded 25 mA as worst case.

name: Visual Alarm Device, Wall Mount, Red - 7.5m coverage
description: Red bodied conventional wall mount VAD with 7.5m coverage.
notes: Shares the BVADW datasheet. Current 10-25 mA dependent on setting; 25 recorded as worst case. NOTE the datasheet labels BVADWR/BVADWW as 'Ceiling Mount' in the order code table while the document title and Mounting Type row say Wall — worth confirming with Brooks before ordering.

name: Visual Alarm Device, Wall Mount, White - 7.5m coverage
description: White bodied conventional wall mount VAD with 7.5m coverage.
notes: Shares the BVADW datasheet; same order-code/mounting-type ambiguity as BVADWR. Current 10-25 mA.

name: High Intensity Strobe with Vibration Pad for Deaf and Hard of Hearing
description: Flashing strobe light with plug-in vibration pad, wireless interconnection to RadioLINK units, unique house-coding, visual RF transmission and power indicators.
notes: Datasheet publishes supply as 230V; no current figure given.

name: High Intensity Strobe for Deaf and Hard of Hearing (strobe only)
description: Strobe-only variant of the deaf and hard of hearing module; wireless interconnection to RadioLINK units, unique house-coding, test button.

name: High Intensity Strobe Light TK86
subcategory: high intensity strobe for hearing impaired
description: High intensity flashing light (4.2J) for use inside the sleeping area to warn hearing impaired occupants; driven from the 12V alarm output.
notes: Currents published as Quiescent@12V / Alarm@12V. 700mA alarm draw is significant for battery sizing. A companion EIB208ST2 is referenced for outside-sleeping-area use.

name: High Intensity Strobe Light (outside sleeping area variant)
subcategory: high intensity strobe for hearing impaired
description: Companion strobe to EIB208ST1 referenced in the BARFS-1 optional field devices datasheet for use outside the sleeping area.
notes: Part number confirmed in the datasheet text and diagrams, but no separate current row is published for ST2 — the current table lists EIB208ST1 only. Do not assume it matches ST1.

name: VisalertPLUS Visual Warning Device, 230V (Deaf & Hard of Hearing)
subcategory: visual warning device for hearing impaired
description: Five ultra-bright cool-white LEDs with wide light coverage; status light indicates mains supply and standby battery state.
notes: Power consumption published as 4 Watts, not mA. Product 147mm diameter x 60.8mm.

name: Address Setting Tool (predecessor to 4414)
description: Earlier generation address setting tool, referenced throughout the FireTracker detector datasheets as an alternative to the 4414 for setting COM loop address and detector mode.
notes: Part number appears repeatedly as '3314 / 4414' in the 4401, 4400, 3309, 2840 and 2841 datasheets, but has no datasheet of its own. Note the 4408 datasheet requires the 4414 specifically.

name: Address Setting Tool
description: Handheld tool to set the COM loop address (001-255) and mode on analogue detector types 33xx / 430x / 440x and all other addressable COM loop units, for use in FT128V2 and FT1020G3 systems. Modes: M1 = 2330 mode (001-127), M2 = 2312 mode (001-127), M3 = Advanced mode.
notes: Battery life approx. 250 hours or up to 50000 read/write operations. Mandatory for setting 440x detectors.

name: Wireless Sniffer (RF Survey Tool)
description: Site survey tool used during planning, installation and commissioning of a wireless system. Checks the environment for background noise and confirms signal strength between the 4611AU detectors and the 4620AU base station, via a simple PC program.
notes: Frequency 916MHz. Useful because RF attenuation from metal, electrical products, high frequency equipment, mobile phones and other wireless systems is difficult to predict.

name: Fireray One Beam Smoke Detector (with 50 m range reflector)
description: Auto-aligning reflective optical beam smoke detector, 5 m to 50 m range with standard reflector.
notes: Operating current 5 mA constant in all modes; fast alignment mode 33 mA. Alarm thresholds selectable 25%/35%/55%/85% obscuration. Individual alarm and fault relays (VFCO) 0.5 A @ 30 Vdc. FRLRK long range reflector kit extends to 120 m. Accessories: FRLI loop interface, FRTST obscuration filter, FRPRM prism, FRPRC protective cage, FRSBB surface back box, FRACH anti-condensation heater, FRDAB adjust

name: Fireray Reflective Hub System with Beam Detector, Prism and System Controller
notes: Operating current 12.5 mA with one detector, 15 mA with two, 17.5 mA with three; fast alignment mode 33 mA. Auxiliary head part number FRHUBDET. Up to 120 m separation with four reflectors in a square pattern.

name: Fireray One (EN) Motorised Beam Detector
supplier: Ampac (Halma) Australia — ampac.net (ampac.com.au no longer resolves to Ampac)
notes: 3 mA in fast alignment mode

name: Press to Release Button for Magnetic Door Holders
description: Momentary action push button in a switch plate, designed to manually release fire or smoke doors held by magnetic door holders. Flush mount as supplied; for surface mount the plate fits a standard mounting block. Single pole, rocker action switch.
notes: The 24Vdc power to the door holders is supplied by the CIE; either +24V or 0V controls the holders via this button. The 10A figure is the switch contact rating, not a consumption figure.

name: MCP Anti-tamper Flap
description: Anti-tamper hinged flap accessory for the MRC series conventional manual call points.

name: Deep Base, White (for Flashni / Roshni / Brooks strobes)
description: White deep base accessory raising the ingress protection of compatible Fulleon sounders, beacons and strobes to IP65.

name: Deep Base, Red (for Flashni / Roshni / Brooks strobes)
description: Red deep base accessory raising the ingress protection of compatible Fulleon sounders, beacons and strobes to IP65.

name: Spare Break Glass Element (10 pack)
description: Spare break glass elements for the MRC series conventional manual call points, supplied in packs of 10.

name: Magnetic Door Holder 50kg, Adjustable Floor/Wall Mount, 15cm
description: Adjustable floor or wall mount magnetic door holder on a 15cm stem, with spring ejector and articulated door plate. Retaining force 100Kgf.
notes: Current 100 mA, drawn CONTINUOUSLY in the standby state — count it in quiescent, not alarm. Compatible with MDHREM remote door release button.

name: Magnetic Door Holder 50kg, Adjustable Floor/Wall Mount, 30cm
description: 30cm stem variant of the adjustable floor/wall mount magnetic door holder, retaining force 100Kgf.
notes: Current 100 mA continuous in standby. Shares the MDH137015 datasheet.

name: Magnetic Door Holder 25/50kg, Wall Mount
description: Wall mount magnetic door holder allowing doors to be held open under normal conditions and automatically released on fire alarm activation. Suits nursing homes, hospitals, schools and industrial premises.
notes: Current published as '40Kgf = 75mA'. This is a CONTINUOUS standby draw (the magnet is energised in the normal state and de-energises on alarm) — it belongs in the quiescent column of a battery calculation, not the alarm column. Compatible with MDHREM remote door release.

name: Magnetic Door Holder 100kg, Wall Mount
description: 100kg retaining force wall mount magnetic door holder.
notes: Shares the MDH1405 datasheet, which publishes only the '40Kgf = 75mA' figure. No current is published specifically for the 100kg model — do NOT assume 75 mA. Energised continuously in standby.

name: Conventional Manual Call Point, NO/NC + Back Box, 9-30V, Break Glass/Reset Option, Red
description: Conventional MCP with dry contact (NO/NC) switching mechanism and back box, with choice of glass or resettable plastic element. 4-way terminal block (in and out for each connection), ABS construction, unique key for test/reset/cover removal.
notes: Temperature range -25 to +55 degC. No current figure is published for this family. Accessories: MRCPHF anti-tamper flap, MRSG spare break glass.

name: Conventional Manual Call Point, NO/NC + Back Box IP66, 9-30V, Break Glass/Reset Option, Red
description: Weather resistant conventional MCP with NO/NC dry contact switching and IP-rated back box.
notes: The datasheet lists IP ratings as 'Standard - IP42, Weather resistant - IP67' while this order code's own description says IP66. No current published.

name: Conventional Manual Call Point, NO/NC + Back Box, Break Glass/Reset Option, White
description: White bodied conventional MCP with NO/NC dry contact switching mechanism and back box.

notes: No current published for this family.

name: Conventional Manual Call Point, Resistive + Back Box IP65, Break Glass/Reset Option, Red
description: Weather resistant resistive conventional MCP with IP-rated back box, 470 or 680 ohm series resistor option.

name: Electronic Bell, 12VDC, Red, 155mm
description: 155mm (6 inch) electronic bell using a miniature solenoid with integrated control circuit, giving excellent sound coverage with minimum current consumption. Locking facility, no backbox required for surface wiring.
notes: Sound output published as a range, 93-95 dB(A); I recorded the conservative 93. Current 60 mA at 12VDC (the 24VDC models draw only 30 mA).

name: Electronic Bell, 12VDC, Weatherproof, Red, 155mm
description: Weatherproof 155mm electronic bell for external use, 12VDC.

name: Electronic Bell, 24VDC, Weatherproof, Red, 155mm
description: Weatherproof 155mm electronic bell for external use, 24VDC.

name: Electronic Bell, 240VAC, Red, 155mm
description: 155mm mains powered electronic bell for internal use.

name: Electronic Bell, 240VAC, Weatherproof, Red, 155mm
description: Weatherproof 155mm mains powered electronic bell for external use.
notes: No mA figure published for the 240VAC variants. Sound output 93-95 dB(A).

name: Roshni Low Profile (RoLP) Sounder, 9-28VDC, Red
description: The Roshni Low Profile is a widely used conventional fire alarm sounder with wide operating voltage and a range of selectable tones. High sound output with low current consumption.
notes: Current 16 mA and sound output 102 dB(A) are both quoted at TONE 3 — other tones will differ. Compatible mains base BR240V (240V red).

name: Roshni Low Profile (RoLP) Sounder, 9-28VDC, White
description: White bodied variant of the Roshni Low Profile conventional sounder.
notes: Current 16 mA and 102 dB(A) both quoted at tone 3. Shares the MRSC datasheet.

name: Squashni Sounder Base
description: Base sounder presenting the qualities of the Roshni in a form usable with almost any available fire detector. The flat deck area also accepts beacons, giving a compact audio-visual alarm device at a single installation point.
notes: Current published as '35mA max'. Sound output 93 dB(A) at TONE 3. Volume control range 20 dB.

name: Flashni Sounder Beacon 12VDC, White Body with Amber Strobe & Deep Base
description: 12 volt version of the Flashni sounder beacon, white body with amber strobe and deep base.
